words: The Cottonwood landing root irpt-cot-account-return-daily-lambda was built with no layers, while its adapter imports pyarrow at module level and the python3.12 runtime does not carry pyarrow, so the first invocation would fail on import. This cell adds one read-only aws_lambda_layer_version data source for irpt-performance-native-layer and one layers line on the module call in lambda.tf, in the same form the account-dim root uses, and touches no other code line and no other root file. The latest version of the existing layer was read live as version 1 and lists python3.12; the sibling function irpt-cot-account-dim-lambda reports python3.12 and the same version 1 layer ARN. Not proven by this cell: no terraform plan, no apply, no invoke, no layer publish, and no run of the function on the Lambda runtime. Also not proven: that the layer's pyarrow version is the one the adapter was measured with at round 125.
